i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load issue 356, the three target loops, config schema, CLI surface, downstream surfaces (sampled backtest, build_rolling_compound_priors, run_sampled_runtime_comparison), glossary. Record pass when loaded.

q1-goal.title: Primary goal of the knob
q1-goal.imperative: Fast full runs, low-and-slow background, or both? RESOLVED: both equally; default should be the safe middle.

q2-scope.title: Parallelization scope
q2-scope.imperative: Three training loops only, or everything? RESOLVED: everything in one PR — 4 gold-cycle phases (train mains, LOSO, calibration, sampled backtest) PLUS the 2 standalone scripts (build_rolling_compound_priors, run_sampled_runtime_comparison). Legacy run_full_pipeline.py excluded.

q3-gold-cli.title: --utilization behavior in gold mode
q3-gold-cli.imperative: Gold mode rejects mutating overrides. RESOLVED: --utilization is always allowed as a non-policy runtime hint; applied directly to config after load, never recorded in applied_overrides.

q4-knob-values.title: Knob value representation
q4-knob-values.imperative: Named levels or float? RESOLVED: three named levels only (background/balanced/max). No 0.0-1.0 float.

q5-mechanism.title: Execution mechanism
q5-mechanism.imperative: ProcessPoolExecutor, joblib, or subprocess? RESOLVED: stdlib ProcessPoolExecutor with worker initializer; n_workers==1 short-circuits to an in-process loop (no pool/pickling) so background == today's path.

q6-determinism.title: Determinism guarantee
q6-determinism.imperative: What guarantee do we commit to and test? RESOLVED: byte-identical at a FIXED threads_per_worker regardless of n_workers (input-order reassembly + self-seeded units); metric-identical within tolerance across thread counts.

q7-module-home.title: Home of the shared core
q7-module-home.imperative: Where does the reusable core live? RESOLVED: src/utils/utilization.py (Data region, bottom layer; evo->utils import sanctioned). Nothing F1-specific in it.

q8-gold-default.title: Committed default level in gold_defaults.toml
q8-gold-default.imperative: What utilization value ships as the gold default? RECOMMEND: balanced (matches 'safe middle'), with background being the safest for a shared machine and max for finish-ASAP. Confirm balanced vs background vs max.

q9-ram-cap.title: RAM cap parameterization
q9-ram-cap.imperative: How is the memory-based worker cap configured? RECOMMEND: a named constant mem_per_worker_gb=1.0 + cap from psutil available memory; NOT user-configurable in v1 (YAGNI); log a line when the cap binds. Confirm vs making it a TOML/CLI knob.

q10-test-scope.title: Determinism test coverage across surfaces
q10-test-scope.imperative: Which surfaces does the acceptance determinism test exercise? RECOMMEND: a tiny smoke gold cycle is the canonical byte-identity test (covers run_jobs + training + sampled backtest); the 2 scripts get lighter 'runs under 2 workers and matches 1-worker output' smoke checks. Confirm vs full determinism test on every surface.

consolidation.summary: Utilization knob fully scoped. CORE: src/utils/utilization.py (Data region) exposing resolve_resource_plan, init_worker, run_jobs (ProcessPoolExecutor; n_workers==1 short-circuits to in-process). Three named levels background/balanced/max mapping to (workers,threads,priority) with workers*threads~=cores and a non-user-facing RAM auto-cap (mem_per_worker_gb=1.0, logged when binding). SCOPE: one PR covering all 4 gold-cycle phases (train mains, LOSO, calibration, sampled backtest incl. per-race refactor of backtest_sampled_runtime) PLUS both standalone scripts (build_rolling_compound_priors, run_sampled_runtime_comparison); legacy run_full_pipeline.py excluded. CONFIG/CLI: utilization in GoldCycleRuntimeConfig (default balanced in gold_defaults.toml); --utilization allowed in gold mode as a non-policy hint applied post-load, never in applied_overrides. DETERMINISM: byte-identical at fixed threads regardless of n_workers; tolerance across thread counts; canonical test is a tiny smoke gold cycle (1w vs Nw byte-identity) + lighter parallel-matches-sequential checks on the 2 scripts. Failure: fail_fast surfaces first error with job identity, pool torn down. Logging: input-order reassembly, completed-count + wall-clock ETA, plan logged once per phase.
